spec_match.rationale: Probes only what the platform exposes to a page: relList.supports keyword, link.rel round-trip, PerformanceResourceTiming.contentEncoding presence, secure-context.

interactive.rationale: Runs four live checks with pass/fail/info verdicts read from the real APIs; no server round trip.

edge_cases.rationale: Explicitly states each check's limits (keyword support != v156 request-semantics change); contentEncoding treated as info when absent.

conformance.rationale: conformance.json asserts client-observable contracts (rel keyword recognised, rel round-trips, secure context) and marks the server-dependent request-semantics/negotiation as manual.

runtime_evidence.rationale: Headless 141 (localhost secure context): relList.supports=true, link.rel round-trips, contentEncoding absent (info), secure=true; console clean; verified via autorun DOM.

telemetry_health.rationale: showcaseTelemetry.assert on the real and route-unavailable branches.

design_system.rationale: CSS variables only; button bg+color together; WCAG AA; amber requirement notes.

accessibility.rationale: Native controls, aria-live status, table caption/scope, visible focus.

mobile_desktop_parity.rationale: No horizontal overflow at 360 or 1280; tap targets >=44px; both classes verified.

guidanceConsulted.query: feature detection unsupported API fallback state accessible status region
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Communicate async/dynamic state through role=status/aria-live; use native controls with visible labels; semantic tables with caption/scope.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Support verdict and step readouts use role=status / <output aria-live=polite>; controls are native buttons/selects; step and fact lists use semantic markup.
guidanceConsulted.evidence: Headless a11y: support banner announced on resolve; buttons carry text names; focus visible.

guidanceConsulted.query: responsive control panel and code blocks on narrow mobile without horizontal overflow
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Contain wide content (pre/tables) with overflow-x:auto and scrollbar-gutter:stable; grid auto-fit for control rows; no body horizontal overflow.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Code samples use <pre> with overflow; step/col grids use repeat(auto-fit,minmax); measured no overflow at 360 and 1280.
guidanceConsulted.evidence: CDP: overflow=0px at 360x740 DPR3 and 1280x800 on all concept pages.

summary: A fully client-side, real capability read that runs correctly on the baseline. It is careful to state that recognising the keyword does not prove the v156 request-semantics update, which is server-observable only.
